name: Time bands before 10:00 and after 21:00 are off by default (Schedule-II)

attrs.quote: Time Bands (i), (ii), (iii) and (ix) shall be default OFF for all customers
attrs.scope: all customers, including those who registered no preference
attrs.note: Bands (i) to (iii) are 00:00 to 10:00 and band (ix) is 21:00 to 24:00, so preference-based delivery runs 10:00 to 21:00 unless the customer switches a band on.
